notes.title: Improvements
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Trainers! 👋[/b][/h1]

Welcome back to the new devlog! This is one of the last devlogs before the release of the full version of Animal Trainer Simulator. 🐶 Today, we’d like to tell you a bit about some changes and features introduced to the game after listening to [b]your requests[/b]. 

First of all, many of you were concerned with leaving your animals in the car when you left the vehicle for a moment- that’s why [b]we’ll introduce information about the air conditioning switched on[/b] when you leave the car. 💨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/9ecee087c0a884d081824c49cd41bbb0e36dcaa1.png[/img]
Another frequently mentioned topic was the fact you’ve found the quality of some translations lacking. We agree and the full version will receive significant improvements in this area as well! 👍

You’ve also pointed out that some areas are empty, that’s why we’ve decided to address this issue with three different improvements:

[list]1. We’ve added more decoratives throughout the entire map to make the are feel more filled 🌳

2. We’ve added more people in areas near both your and your clients’ houses to make them more lively 🏃

3. Last but not least we’ve added some cute static dogs sitting next to their owners while they’re interacting with other people. 🐕[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/16d6e4899e99b62a1eab94adfa13a8a563509eaf.png[/img]
There are more things to be added in the full version but we’ll leave them for you to discover! We hope you’ve enjoyed this short devlog. If you still haven’t done so, we encourage you to try the Prologue version of our game, it’s free to play! ❤️‍

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2199860/Animal_Trainer_Simulator/

notes.title: Competitions
notes.content:
[h1][b]Dear Players! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h3]We’re happy to see you in yet another devlog from Animal Trainer Simulator! ❤️‍ Today’s topic will surely catch the attention of every player who enjoys competing. That’s right- today we’ll talk about animal competitions! 🤩[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/4b8322a57680db68b8ceccd36159edc30e84967c.jpg[/img]
During your gameplay, you’ll get to compete in various events in which you can start with both your own animals or the ones that are currently in training. 🏇

The competition has three stages, each of them having their own random arena layout. You’ll compete against AI opponents and you won’t see them during the competition- all you have to do is focus on passing the obstacle course as quickly as possible. ⏱️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/8bdb330f1d2888871c22b03e96550647d38f2aa4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/8786c2808bd1396687525f1ab0b81246258bfbe3.jpg[/img]
[h3]The final score consists of the time it took your pupil to pass the entire track and in case any obstacle was skipped- a time penalty will be added to your final score. 

[b]This is a part where the amount of the training really shines because well-trained animal will be less likely to skip or fail the obstacle! 🐶[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/8976068e90bd2ceb16a24d34ac0cede1df0b7663.jpg[/img]
At the end of each round you’ll be given points which are summarized after the competition to show the final score. 📝 The prizes consist of special points which can be exchanged for some extraordinary items! 💪 We don’t want to spoil the fun so the functions of those items will be left for you to discover but we can assure you won’t be disappointed! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/f7dbd3f6815f366ba930bef4cd690254f586594d.jpg[/img]
[b]As always, we’d love to hear from you whether you like the new mechanic or not. 🙂 Perhaps you’ve got an interesting idea or suggestion about the contents of the game? Make sure to let us know in the discussion section or on our discord! Don’t forget to add the game to your wishlists to not miss out on any of the upcoming info! 👍[/b]

notes.title: Enviroment
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Players! 👋[/b][/h1]

Before we dig into today’s devlog we’d like to once again [b]thank you all for taking part in the Playtest[/b]! We’re grateful for all the feedback you’ve provided us with and now we understand more in which direction you’d like the game to go! 👍

notes.title: Animal breeds
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Animal Traners! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h3]We’re happy to have you back with us in another devlog from Animal Trainer Simulator! 🐶 For the last month we’ve been working really hard to introduce diversity to the models of horses and dogs which will be available in the game. 👏[/h3]

We wanted their looks and characteristics not only to be as diverse as possible but also for those different characteristics to have an actual impact on the gameplay! 📝

[b]Finally, our work brought some quality results and the breeds and races of animals will matter if you want to train them. 🤩[/b] Some animal races because of their inborn attitude are more or less prone to learning new commands or tricks. On top of that, the race will also have an impact on the time you need to spend with an animal for it to achieve the set training goals ⏱️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/04a72863d0117da84f315b54a199a2652d9f3448.png[/img]


[h3][b]There will be many dog races, such as:[/b][/h3]

🐾 Akita Inu
🐾 Border Collie
🐾 Dalmatian
🐾 Doberman
🐾 Golden Retriever
🐾 Husky
🐾 Labrador
🐾 German Shepherd
🐾 Pitbull

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/f8b6fb2fde488d07e7ff72be44e751322dfc6d5c.png[/img]


[h3]And because of the extremely different features of character those breeds display we could sort them into two general categories: [/h3]

[b]Easier to train ✅[/b]
Which are the Border Collie Golden Retriever Labrador, German Shepherd

[b]Harder to train 🤏[/b]
Akita Inu, Dalmatian, Husky, Pitbull

[b]Dobermans on the other hand, on top of their abilities are great learners when it comes to attack and defense training with the use of training dummies because of their strong protective instinct and inborn courage! 💝[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/cae3831f1168a7997b7e114b9a2f819ae8f2d53d.png[/img]


[h3][b]You’ll be able to train the dogs in the following activities/commands 🧐:[/b][/h3]

-Down
-Speak
-Shake
-Stand on two paws
-Training Dummy attack
-Ramp Walking
-Ring Jumping
-Slalom

[b]Some of your animals will be more prone to learn certain commands/skills where others will struggle ☝️[/b]


[h3]Once again, being a good animal trainer is a very complicated subject and requires a lot of knowledge about each particular animal you’re dealing with.[/h3]


Let us know in the comments what you think about this aspect of our game ❗ We can’t wait to hear your opinions and suggestions! As always, we’d love to invite you to join our discord community and to add our game to your wishlists on Steam! 👇

One of the methods available for training from the very beginning of the game is [b]an obstacle course[/b]. 🐕 Using a minigame in which you lead dog/horse on the propper element of the course. The animal which learns everything it was supposed to, will be able to leave your training center with completed training! 🤩

notes.title: Cars
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Trainers! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h3]As you most certainly know, our game’s main objective is to train your clients’ animals. 🐕 To deliver the highest quality of your service you’ll also have to be ready to pick them up at home and once you finish the training- driving them back. 🐴[/h3]

[h2]For that purpose players will own a car… actually not just one car.[/h2] 🚙

[h3]We’ve added [b]“Car DealerShop”[/b] to the game. It's a place which was created to meet all of your automotive expectations and needs. 🚚 [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/d80f5fd4216f4cc75ea26fe7443aef0314384a82.png[/img]
[h3]Because of the vast difference in sizes of the transported animal e.g. Horses and dogs you’ll need something bigger than a car. Therefore, we’ve introduced pickups to the game! 👍[/h3]

Players will be able to do their shopping there using the cash earned through their work! 💰 They’ll be different from each other in the following aspects:

[b]- looks,
- engine power,
- capacity of the storage trunk,
- number of seats required to transport pets.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/25dcfda30cb6d8ef6144644fa746cbf9d96f204c.png[/img]
[h3]On top of that, you’ll also be able to buy all kinds of frailers which will help you during horse or even horses transportation. (depending on a model) 🤩[/h3]

At this point you may have wondered… Where will I keep all those vehicles I buy? Don’t worry! You’ll be able to store all of them in your private bottomless garage which basically means, you can have as many cars as you’d like!  🙂 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/c267ab8344c5bffd3e09b67d98dd6be80d122b22.png[/img]
You’ll be able to choose the car you’ll drive through the players' garage menu situated nearby the house! 😀 With all of that said, pick your ride and enjoy your time driving through the picturesque landscapes of Animal Trainer Simulator! ⛰️

If you enjoy the development process of our game, [b]consider joining our discord community 👇 and adding our game to your wishlists[/b] 👇.

notes.title: Personal Pets!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Trainers! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h3]We’re back with another update from our animal training facility! 🤩 Today we’d like introduce you to [b]something you’ve frequently asked for[/b]. Animals are undoubtedly the main stars of our production and helping them and their owners is your task. But why should you not be able to become an owner yourself...[/h3]

[h2]Therefore, we are happy to announce players will now be able to have their own animals! 👍[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/cb084f1f3b1238451601a989329df88ab5442973.png[/img]
[h3]Currently, players have a possibility to take care of a dog and a horse.[/h3]

[b]To adopt a pupil you’ll have to visit an Animal Shelter [/b]😜 where different animals will await you. After choosing the most charming one, you’ll have to [b]name it, take care of it and train it if you’d like to teach it some skills.[/b] 🐕 It’s up to you whether your personal pupil will undergo the training. 🙂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/f5492127645e74eb016f783266fd7565b6417f1f.png[/img]
Your pupils, unlike those you’re taking care of at work, will be able to spend time with you at home, will follow you and will be allowed to join you during trips❣️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/f5492127645e74eb016f783266fd7565b6417f1f.png[/img]
You’ll be able to use your personal horse companion to venture to the city or have a little ride around the facility. 👏
